name: spotify-clone-monorepo
description: High-performance, industry-standard Spotify Clone with Express.js backend and Vite React Tailwind frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:server && npm run install:client
